product.name: Pyroscope Open Source Continuous Profiling Platform
product.description: An open-source continuous profiling tool that collects and analyzes application performance data to identify CPU and memory usage issues.

product.name: Pyroscope Cloud (Grafana Cloud Profiles)
product.description: A managed cloud service for continuous profiling that integrates with Grafana Cloud to provide scalable and secure profiling data storage and analysis.

product.name: FlameQL Query Engine
product.description: A query engine that enables custom queries and aggregation of profiling data for efficient performance analysis.

product.name: Low-overhead Profiling Agents
product.description: Agents that collect profiling data with minimal impact on application performance, supporting multiple programming languages.

product.name: Profile Exemplars Integration
product.description: Links profiling data with OpenTelemetry tracing to provide request- or span-specific performance profiles.

product.name: Pyroscope Integrations
product.description: Integrations with observability tools like Honeycomb, Jaeger, Grafana, AWS Lambda, Prometheus, and Slack to enhance profiling data usage.
